instruction: How can I enable location services so that apps can access my current geographic position?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because enabling location services requires GPS hardware or network-based location detection capabilities that are not present in the VM environment. Even if the location settings UI could be accessed, there is no way to verify that location services are actually providing geographic coordinates.
